welcomeIntro: From a paper or dataset to reproducible results.
welcomeBody: Read, think and work with your research agent.
understandPrompt: Read the project files and documentation. Summarize the research goals, available materials and useful next steps.
analyzePrompt: Inspect the data files, assess data quality and suitable analysis methods, then propose a reproducible analysis plan.
literaturePrompt: Find literature related to this project with real DOIs and sources. Distinguish existing evidence from research hypotheses.
getStarted: Open a project folder and configure a model API in settings.
taskPlaceholder: Describe your research task or tell the agent what to do next…
executionNotice: Files and commands run locally · Online models receive relevant task context
jobsDescription: Commands run in the current project folder. Long-running jobs can be cancelled independently.
memoryDescription: Save research preferences and project context. Each new turn reads the latest memory.
memoryPlaceholder: For example: use color-blind-friendly charts and report effect sizes with statistical results.
automationsDescription: Start research sessions on a schedule while the app runs. Closing the window keeps it in the tray; quitting or sleeping pauses execution.
automationPlaceholder: For example: find new papers on this project topic and save new entries with DOIs to literature.md.
projectPathHelp: Enter the absolute path of an existing folder.
providerDescription: Connect directly to a provider or local model. Keys are stored on this device; providers handle billing.
keySaved: Saved; leave blank to keep it
keyOptional: Optional for local services without authentication
modelIdHelp: Enter the exact model ID from your provider
savedConfig: Saved. API keys are stored in the system keychain.
fileEmpty: Open a project to browse source materials and generated results.
networkError: Cannot reach the local service. Check that the app is still running.
